No contract, wallet, economy or deployment change; edits stay in web/src and web/index.html.
escalations: NEAR drawing-session experiment (board-review step 4) stays ask-first: authorizing a function-call key limited to the board's draw method with a bounded gas allowance, plain-language activation/remaining-allowance/renewal/revoke, and verified on-chain key removal touches wallet signing, key creation and a testnet deployment; needs a human decision on allowance scope plus a funded testnet account and game contract identifier before a brief can be written.

Saturated palette proposal (docs/2026-10-12-palette-proposal.md) remains ask-first: moving past the eight-color contract palette changes metadata coordinated across web/shared/contract and the meaning of already-stored colors; per the judgment doc ('ask first: ... economy changes', contract changes) it needs a tier-2 decision-record update in docs/00-shared-decisions.md before any implementation task is written.
